row.body: The hand shovel and wash pail share white crystals from the orchard spray test. They were bundled before the bridge was blocked.
row.title: Hand shovel and wash pail, the late afternoon

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same white crystals while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

row.body: A pencil lies through a ring of playing cards. The score sheet counts one more player than the chairs, and a later hand has rubbed the extra column thin.
row.title: An empty seat at the table

sidecar.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
